title: Docling extraction accuracy on generated invoice and agreement PDFs
scope: Optional evidence for the proposal: render synthetic invoice and agreement PDFs from the TAX-118 population (including scans with noise), extract them with the pinned Docling deployment and measure field accuracy against the generator's values

acceptance.text: Generate at least 100 synthetic PDFs (clean and degraded) from TAX-118 records with the true field values kept outside the extraction input
Run the TAX-038 Docling adapter on them and report per-field accuracy (supplier TIN, invoice number, date, net, VAT) with error examples; a Docling outage is reported as not tested, never estimated
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Run the TAX-038 Docling adapter on them and report per-field accuracy (supplier TIN, invoice number, date, net, VAT) with error examples; a Docling outage is reported as not tested, never estimated

notes.text: Added 2026-11-06 as a follow-up to TAX-118 (results that need documents or people).
